text:
It's as Anja said. 
Legally you are not allowed to enter Israel with the intention to settle before getting a proper entry clearance for that purpose (that is the embassy process).

Alternatively, your partner could return to Israel and submit an application in Israel, which once approved will allow you to enter and continue the process here (this would be faster to the partner visa in comparison to the embassy route, but more time separated from one another).
